newsitem.title: USA: CMS Energy unit gets financing in Argentina.
newsitem.headline: CMS Energy unit gets financing in Argentina.

text.p: CMS Energy Corp said its independent power unit, CMS Generation Co, closed financing on the 128-megawatt YPF-La Plata Cogeneration Project, a gas-fueled power plant under construction in Argentina.
The $75 million financing was closed with the U.S. Overseas Private Investment Corporation. The limited recourse financing is for a term of 12 years.
The plant, which is expected to commence operation this summer, is 100 percent owned by CMS Generation.
Construction of the YPF-La Plata Project began in April 1996 on the site of a petroleum refinery outside Buenos Aires owned by YPF SA.

The plant will supply 73 megawatts of its electric capacity to YPF's refineries at La Plata and Lujan de Cuyo in Mendoza Province, as well as 200 tons per hour of industrial process steam to the La Plata refinery under a long term contract.
The remaining electricity will be sold on Argentina's electric grid. CMS Generation will operate the facility.
